# Sources independent of the RTL: patent US 4,325,121 (FIG. 17/18, App. H by label), manual (M68000PRM par. 4, instruction descriptions), measurements against the reference core with comparison benches made during development, not part of this repository (available from the author on request: diff-fuzz-si per instruction family, lockstep-si, reset) (lockstep-si also in opcode sweep mode).

column6: CONFIRMED: row 0 is "no row" of the FIG. 18 decoder (instructions that FIG. 18 does not classify: LEA, PEA, JMP, MOVEM, Bcc...); their microwords use column 1 as a pass-through (docs/silicon-datapath.md §9.5: operand d = the constant −1, AND with it is a pass-through with flags; App. H alu column '1n'); measurement: diff-fuzz-si families LEA, PEA, MOVEM, MOVEMR and lockstep-si in sweep mode over the 65,536 opcodes

CONFIRMED: App. H aixw0/aixl0/ldmx1 "(dbin) -> ab* -> alu" with alu column '5n' (sign extension of the indexed d8) serve instructions with no row (LEA/PEA/JMP/MOVEM with d8(An,Xn)); measurement: diff-fuzz-si families LEA and PEA (d8(An,Xn) modes) and lockstep-si in sweep mode

CONFIRMED: M68000PRM par. 4, DIVS/DIVU: "V set if division overflow, cleared otherwise; C always cleared"; the sheet has only EXT; measurement: diff-fuzz-si families DIVU and DIVS (including the overflow cases)

CONFIRMED: M68000PRM par. 4, ROXd: "C set according to the last bit rotated out; if the rotate count is zero, C is set to the value of X"; the sheet has KNZ00; measurement: diff-fuzz-si family ROXR and lockstep-si in sweep mode
CONFIRMED: as above, for ROXL; measurement: diff-fuzz-si family ROXL and lockstep-si in sweep mode

CONFIRMED: M68000PRM par. 4, NBCD/SBCD: "Z cleared if the result is nonzero, unchanged otherwise" -> Z is not the one of the operation: D instead of Z; the sheet has ~CNZV~C; measurement: diff-fuzz-si families NBCD and SBCD
CONFIRMED: M68000PRM par. 4, NOT: "C always cleared"; the sheet has KNZV~C; measurement: diff-fuzz-si family NOT
CONFIRMED: as above (NOT in memory); measurement: diff-fuzz-si family NOT

CONFIRMED: App. H aixw0/ldmx1 "(dbin) -> ab* -> alu" column '5n' (extension of the indexed d8) with an instruction of row 15 (FIG. 18 line 14 "scc,movb": MOVE.B); the sheet has '-' in row 15 column 5; measurement: diff-fuzz-si family MOVE, case MOVE.B d8(PC,Xn),D0: same D0 and same CCR as the reference (without EXT the effective address would be wrong)
